channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker

item.title: Kremlin adviser warns UK drone factories could face attacks
item.description: Russia says UK decision to share missile blueprints with Ukraine is evidence of direct military involvement in the war.

item.title: Who are Iran’s top trading partners US would need to target to isolate it?

item.description: Shiru Kihara, a nurse in Kenya, explains why she and thousands of other nurses are on strike demanding fair pay.

item.title: Pakistan says significant progress made in talks on Iran-US war

item.description: Netanyahu's claim comes after US and Israel killed Iran's supreme leader and four members of his family in Tehran.

item.title: Man killed in world’s largest annual bullfighting event in Mexico
item.description: The world’s largest open road bullfighting event turned deadly when a 29-year-old man was killed.

item.title: Brutal gang attack on strategic Haiti hillside leaves at least 30 dead

item.title: Iran says it is 'fully prepared' to counter widened US economic sanctions
item.description: The US calls its latest sanctions on Iran an "economic D-Day", but Tehran says it has a plan to address them.
